features: Parallel decode results retain up to 64 messages within 96 MiB, rather than dropping all but four; one oversized foreground image can exceed the budget alone
Four metadata workers, up to twelve decoders, bounded full-size work; useful queued neighbours survive navigation
Forward/backward preloads; small texture uploads drain up to sixteen per frame within a 5 ms scheduling budget
RAW rating controls shared with main UI; RAW crop editor reuses the main geometry, handles, presets and undo
Crop ratio lock rendered as a vector lock icon with accessible tooltip; no emoji/font dependency
Native parent disabled for the full child lifetime; main-frame keyboard events blocked; restore only after child exit and receipt acknowledgement
Ordinary close automatically saves current exposure/WB/basics/rating and unapplied crop; failures retain editor and drafts
Failed receipts queue in order across later saves; main receives explicit fields, protects crop/orientation and refreshes the exposure anchor
